authorization: 用户指定新的站立三视图作为标准重新生成；每次只生成三张，生成原图后停下交用户检查。
scope: 既有9张动作表的第1–3张；本轮严格只提交3个图片任务。
commonPrompt:
Create a clean finished 2D cartoon action sheet of FURO. The single attached image is the USER-APPROVED THREE-VIEW CHARACTER MODEL SHEET and is the definitive standard for Furo. All character artwork in this request MUST keep that exact identity, face, hair, proportions, short limbs and small feet. The reference shows the same character from the front, left profile and back; it is not a request to reproduce a turnaround. The OUTPUT must instead contain exactly FOUR requested action illustrations in a 2 by 2 arrangement.
IDENTITY: Match the approved reference's very large rounded head, pale dusty cherry-pink short bob with the same pointed hair ends, black horizontal side clips and black geometric bang clips in the same positions. Cream-white face, large rose-red eyes with the same shape and scale, light pink cheeks and a tiny w-shaped mouth. Match the gentle dark-brown outline and soft warm color palette. Use the approved reference's compact white torso and two short white rounded forepaws. No animal ears, tail, new hair ornaments or human fingers. No shoes or clothes unless an individual action specifically calls for a prop or accessory.
ANATOMY: The approved standing torso has a clear vertical section below the head, simple short legs at its base and tiny low dark-chocolate foot tips. In standing actions, preserve the front reference's proportions and balance: head roughly two thirds of total height, upright torso with short legs and small feet the remaining third. Brown foot tips are approximately 4 to 6 percent of standing height, low and grounded. NEVER turn the feet into large raised oval soles or a wide seated spread. Do not shorten a standing torso into a crouching ball. Arms remain short rounded forepaws attached just below the head, without long legs, knees or an added neck. Seated actions must be clear natural seated adaptations of this SAME anatomy: fold the short legs modestly while keeping the head size, torso volume and small brown foot ends; do not add oversized paw pads or redesign the mascot. Sleeping and bathing poses retain the same recognizable head and body anatomy beneath their props.
STYLE: Preserve the approved model sheet's smooth warm 2D cartoon illustration, clean dark-brown outlines, restrained soft shading and gentle upper-left highlights. Balanced detail; no pixel art, 3D rendering, photorealism, paper grain, sketch lines or overly glossy finish. Each full character and all requested props fit safely inside its own cell. Pure white #FFFFFF background, no floor shadow, room scenery, letters, text, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, watermark, grid lines or panel borders. Never draw HMM, ZZZ or LEVEL UP. Draw only the objects and effects explicitly requested for that cell.
LAYOUT: Square 1:1 raw artwork sheet with exactly FOUR equal cells: TOP LEFT, TOP RIGHT, BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM RIGHT. Keep generous clear white gutters and at least 8% margin inside each cell so no silhouette touches a neighboring cell or the canvas edge. Keep the same character head size and line weight across all four drawings. Front-facing or slight three-quarter poses as appropriate to the action; the approved model sheet governs all visible anatomy. This is the original artwork for human review, not a labeled presentation or an exploded layer diagram.

cells.description: Calm content SITTING pose, short forepaws resting naturally in front of the belly, modest small dark-brown foot tips visible. Bright relaxed rose-red eyes and tiny gentle w-smile. Preserve the approved model sheet anatomy in a comfortable seated adaptation. Clean body. No props or effects.

cells.description: Sitting and visibly hungry: soft pleading eyes, small slightly open mouth, one forepaw on belly, other holding a small empty shallow cream-white plate out to the side. No food, no tears, no dirt.

cells.name: 干净的难过
cells.description: Sitting with a lowered head, drooping brows, sad rose-red eyes and small downturned mouth. Forepaws close together. The face, hair and white body are completely CLEAN. No mud, stains, props or tears.

cells.name: 需要清洁
cells.description: Sitting with a mildly embarrassed expression. A few clearly readable soft brown mud smudges on one cheek, belly and a paw, some on hair ends. Eyes remain recognizably Furo. No heavy crying or shower props.

cells.description: Sleeping peacefully with closed eyes, head on a pale blue pillow, tiny body tucked under a pale blue quilt with two soft white cloud motifs. Complete compact pillow-and-quilt silhouette fully visible, no cropped quilt. No moon, letters or floating sleep symbols.
